name: Cannabis and psychedelics
description: Cannabis, psilocybin, LSD, MDMA, DMT, mescaline, and synthetic cannabinoids: effects, risks, research, state programs, and 2026 legal status.
intro: Cannabis acts on cannabinoid receptors; classic psychedelics such as psilocybin, LSD, DMT, and mescaline act on serotonin 5-HT2A receptors; MDMA releases serotonin and other chemicals. Research into several of them as treatments is advancing quickly.

blocks.p: In April 2026, marijuana in state-licensed medical programs moved to Schedule III, while adult-use cannabis remained Schedule I. Psilocybin is available in state-regulated programs in Oregon and Colorado, and a psilocybin treatment for depression was under FDA review in 2026. All classic psychedelics and MDMA remain Schedule I federally.

blocks.warn: Psychedelics combined with lithium have caused seizures. MDMA or psychedelics combined with MAOIs, including ayahuasca, can cause serotonin syndrome.
